facts.value: Mac-Gray Corporation (laundry facilities management contractor, Waltham, MA; NYSE-listed)

CSC ServiceWorks, Inc., acting through Spin Holdco Inc. (Parent) and CSC Fenway, Inc. (Merger Subsidiary), guaranteed by CSC and CSC ServiceWorks Holdings, Inc.; CSC is a Pamplona portfolio company and Pamplona Capital Partners III, L.P. commits the equity (bid as "CSC/Pamplona")
Strategic (sponsor-owned operating company; financing committed by its sponsor Pamplona)
$21.25 per share in cash; no financing condition; Pamplona commitment of $594 million

The 2011-2012 Discussions (winter 2011 into 2012): Mac-Gray considered acquiring CSC, engaging BofA on 10/23/2012; CSC instead ran its own sale and was bought by Pamplona in May 2013 (p. 27). This was a target-as-buyer effort, not a sale of Mac-Gray. Undated strategic discussions "from time to time" with CSC and other industry participants are also mentioned.
Met (process 1): 20 parties (Party A, CSC/Pamplona, Party B, Party C and 16 unnamed financial parties)

facts.field: Currency and units of bid prices
facts.value: US dollars per Mac-Gray share. Party B 09/18 bid adds options valued by Party B at $2.50 per share (recorded as CVR/earnout, not in price).
BofA Merrill Lynch (Merrill Lynch, Pierce, Fenner & Smith Incorporated)

In April 2013 Mac-Gray's board had BofA Merrill Lynch sound out a strategic rival, Party A, which made an unsolicited $17-19 cash proposal on 06/21/2013. On 06/24 a Special Committee decided to explore a sale and had BofA approach 50 parties, and 20 (2 strategic, 18 financial) signed confidentiality agreements. Preliminary IOIs came from CSC/Pamplona ($18.50), Party B ($17-18) and Party C ($15-17, then $16-16.50), and these three plus Party A advanced to management meetings and staged diligence in which strategic bidders saw less sensitive data. Revised IOIs on 09/09-09/10 ranged from $16-17 to $19.50, and in the final round CSC/Pamplona bid $20.75 with Pamplona's full funding, Party B bid $19.00 cash plus performance options, Party A stood at $18-19 and Party C dropped out. The committee pressed CSC/Pamplona to $21.25 as the price of exclusivity, executed on 09/24/2013 and later extended, and the merger agreement was signed on 10/14/2013 and announced on 10/15/2013.

findings.title: R01 decided: bidder-commitment changes as same-price bids
findings.detail: Whether termination-fee and sponsor-guarantee changes communicated at an unchanged price receive separate same-price Bid events or remain dated terms in Notes. Austin decided by whether the term changes the bidder's ability to walk away.
findings.proposed_change: Check the displayed extraction against the decision: the September 21-23 final package and the October 5 and October 8 sponsor-liability proposals are same-price Bids; the October 7 and October 11 target-fee terms stay in dated Notes.

recorded_decision.decision: Bidder-commitment changes (reverse termination fee, sponsor damages cap or guarantee, adding or dropping a financing or closing condition) are same-price Bids carrying the standing price; the target termination fee stays in a dated Note; target requirements on the bidder's commitment are Other material event.

Exit reason: Value at or below market price
